updates.tweet_text: My job is 99% planning, 1% trading. Before I start day I know: 1) What zones I want to engage 2) What setup at those zones 3) How I'll manage the trades. The actual day is just waiting on triggers/executing. It takes 15 mins per day, is emotionless. Repeat daily to stack points
